title: sambucus pubens f. xanthocarpa
intro: Sambucus pubens f. xanthocarpa, commonly known as the yellow elderberry, is a specific variety of the elderberry plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus pubens f. xanthocarpa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it a popular natural remedy for colds, flu, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
